findings.how_to_check: Run `rg -n "fs_cells" replication/` to confirm that the replication suite contains no reference to `fs_cells.do` or `fs_cells.tex`. Run `replication/run_machineA.do` and verify that `MATCHING/results/fs_cells.tex` is neither generated nor checked.
findings.suggested_fix: Add `MATCHING/fs_cells.do` to `replication/run_machineA.do` (or create a dedicated matching workflow runner), add `link1930_1940_fs*.dta` and `divided_file*_ans_cleaned` to preflight inputs, and add `MATCHING/results/fs_cells.tex` to the output audit in `Run-MachineA.ps1`.
findings.title: Documented replication master does not preflight or execute the new cell table script
findings.what_the_code_does: `MATCHING/fs_cells.do` writes `$REP_REPO/MATCHING/results/fs_cells.tex`, but `replication/run_machineA.do` runs only scripts under `CODE/` (`do "$REP_REPO/CODE/`s'.do"`). Additionally, `run_machineA.do` preflight does not verify the three FamilySearch link files (`link1930_1940_fs*.dta`) or the divided-file directories (`divided_file`y'_ans_cleaned`), and `Run-MachineA.ps1` does not track outputs in `MATCHING/results/`.
findings.why_it_matters: A complete execution of `Run-MachineA.ps1` can succeed with code 0 while leaving `fs_cells.tex` missing or stale. A third-party replicator following `replication/README.md` cannot reproduce the referee-requested cell table from the documented master.

findings.how_to_check: In a fresh Stata session on a system without a `D:/repos` path, leave `REP_REPO` undefined and run `do MATCHING/fs_cells.do`. Stata will halt at line 26 attempting to open the non-existent `D:` drive path.
findings.suggested_fix: Bootstrap `config.do` using relative path `capture do "replication/config.do"` or test file existence across configured machine paths before falling back to the `D:/` default.
findings.title: Standalone execution fallback hardcodes Machine A drive D path to config.do
findings.why_it_matters: On Machine B (`ARTS-ECON-SHSRV`), the repository clone is at `F:/github_repos/fixing_transcription_errors` as declared in `replication/config.do:31`. Launching `fs_cells.do` in a new Stata session where `$REP_REPO` is not preset will crash with file not found error r(601).

review_limits: No paper draft was supplied, so claims-vs-code review was limited to comments, LaTeX labels, and numeric target benchmarks in the source code.

The Stata pipeline was not executed because the review sandbox is read-only and pipeline execution modifies outputs; benchmark values and merge rates were verified by source tracing rather than direct execution.

The external full-count census files (such as the 43 GB labeled census file and 50 state merged_data files) live on external drives outside git and could not be fully loaded or manipulated in this session.

Identification review verified that all five linkage variants share a single common target master, but could not assess the paper draft's interpretation of selection into the discordant target sample or ditto-resolution mechanics.
summary: `MATCHING/fs_cells.do` carefully constructs the referee-requested cell decomposition: it guards against empty-string agreement inflation, isolates incomplete model output, quarantines conflicting identifiers, and verifies that cell aggregates add back to the paper's target row before writing LaTeX output. The primary defect is replication integrity: the master replication script `replication/run_machineA.do` neither preflights nor invokes `fs_cells.do`, meaning the new table is omitted from automated replication runs. Integrating the script and its input dependencies into the documented replication workflow is the most important fix before submission.

verified_clean.item: Human-complete discordant records are partitioned without blank-to-blank agreement inflation.

verified_clean.evidence: The captured `describe` permits only Hawaii to be missing Ancestry/FamilySearch columns; any other state read failure immediately halts execution with exit code 601 at MATCHING/fs_cells.do:59-69.

verified_clean.evidence: Within-`histid` disagreements across rows in `merged_data.dta` are detected, reported, and assigned to cell 0 at MATCHING/fs_cells.do:89-97.
verified_clean.item: Conflicting and duplicate identifiers are quarantined to unclassified cell 0.

verified_clean.item: Middle initial validation avoids empty-string matching.
